# S2.8 — Context label, memory labels & lifecycle, C0 compaction (`evict_oldest`), trigger retrieval, and the `ProcedureProfile/1` + `lift_skill` slice (R-2.4.1 · R-2.4.2⁰ · R-2.4.3 · R-2.4.4 · R-2.4.5⁰)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5c.1–§5c.5
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/039_S2.8__context-label-and-memory.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.4.1 · R-2.4.2⁰ · R-2.4.3 · R-2.4.4 · R-2.4.5⁰**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.7` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)

## Summary

The §5c context/memory slice lands end-to-end at C0: the kernel-stamped
`context_label` recomputes under the same join rule through compaction
(I-LABEL); memory versions carry the full lifecycle precedence walk
(`revoked > superseded > expired > stale_by_dependency > valid >
unknown`) with the **`scope_ended` implicit floor** checked before any
contract; `compact` is the kernel driver over the closed
`CompactionTrigger`/`CompactionOp` sums enforcing I-CUT/I-REQ/I-PAIR/
I-ATOM/I-NOWIDEN on every proposal, with the I-FALLBACK ladder ending in
the deterministic, model-call-free `evict_oldest` rung (or
`CompactionImpossible` on hard failure); retrieval gains the
`PathTouched → procedure_pointer.triggers[].path_glob` trigger arm; and
the `ProcedureProfile/1` slice lands — closed predicate grammar,
`uncheckable` counted never errored, total failure-handler coverage,
capability allowlist, composition-cycle and risk-floor checks, the C0
`instruction` target with typed refusals for `workflow_node`/
`subagent_task`, and `lift_skill` producing claims-never-grants at
`external` text authority.

### `crates/hh-context`

- **`compact.rs`** (new, ~1.4k lines) — the kernel compaction driver:
  `CompactionTrigger` closed sum + `hardness`; `assess`
  (`target_reclaim`/`min_reclaim`); the closed `CompactionOp` grammar;
  `check_proposal` enforcing I-CUT (ops only at `legal_cut_points`),
  I-REQ (never a `required` item), I-PAIR/I-ATOM (indivisible groups
  drag whole), I-NOWIDEN (labels/authorities/readers/retention never
  touched); `execute` producing the `CompactedView` with
  kernel-authority omission items (`OMISSION_ITEM_TOKENS = 8`),
  `context_label_after` recomputed over surviving expanded items, and
  `forgotten ∪ view =` the pre-compaction view; `evict_oldest_propose`
  evicting in `PRIORITY_CLASSES` order and stopping on the **net**
  reclaim estimate (ADR-0270 D4 — a gross stop could strand the rung
  short of `min_reclaim`); `compact` running the I-FALLBACK ladder
  (variants → `proposal.fallback` → `fallback_variant` → kernel
  `evict_oldest` → `CompactionImpossible` hard / unchanged view soft)
  under `context.compaction.started`/`completed` rows.
- **`procedure.rs`** (new) — `ProcedureIndexEntry`, `select_procedures`
  (C0 `index_all_under_budget`, OQ-198; emits
  `context.procedure.selected`), the `procedure_index` (handle-only)
  and `procedure_body` candidate projections, `activate` →
  `context.artefact.activated{detector: deterministic, signal:
  loaded}`, and `detect_followed` (allowed capability ∧ index
  `delivery_id ∈ causes[]` — evidence, never a verdict).
- **`lifecycle.rs`** — `scope_ended` precedence-floor expiry:
  `lifecycle_state` checks `MemoryStore::scope_ended` before the
  contract walk → `expired{reason: "scope_ended"}` for run-scoped
  versions after `mark_scope_ended` (AC-R-2.4.4-8).
- **`retrieve.rs`** — `TriggerKind::PathTouched` enumerates
  `procedure_pointer` memories whose `triggers[].path_glob` matches the
  touched path; `context.retrieval.completed{query_kind: trigger}`.
- **`events.rs`** — `compaction_started`/`compaction_completed`/
  `procedure_selected` payload builders.

### `crates/hh-hir`

- **`procedure.rs`** (new, ~1.3k lines) — the §5c.5 static half:
  `ProcedureProfile/1` on `ext["hh/procedure"]` (fail-closed decode —
  unknown members are `SchemaViolation`); the closed `Predicate` sum;
  `check_preconditions`/`PreconditionEnv`/`PreconditionReport`
  (uncheckable counted); `FailureClass`/`Handler`/`FailureHandler` with
  `covers` wildcards; `ProcedureParameter`; `select_target` →
  `instruction` (`UnexpressibleAsWorkflow`/`DelegationUnavailable`
  typed refusals); `validate_procedure` covering render-purity
  (`RenderTimeExecution`), capability allowlist
  (`CapabilityNotAllowed`), loop bounds, `$param` declaration
  (`UnboundParameter`), handler totality (`HandlerIncomplete`),
  composition refs + cycles (`CompositionCycle`), and the risk floor
  (`ProcedureUnverifiable`).
- **`errors.rs`/`lib.rs`/`validate.rs`** — new `HirError` variants
  exported; `validate_procedure` runs per `Procedure` node;
  `uncheckable_preconditions` recorded on the report.

### `crates/hh-registry`

- **`skill.rs`** (new) — `lift_skill`: one `Procedure`, one
  `Instruction(Text)` body at `external`; `allowed-tools` →
  `DeclaredClaim`s (claims, never grants — `allowed_capabilities` stays
  empty until a seal-time `authorizes` edge); `scripts/*` →
  `Opaque(CompiledPayload{exec})`; `references/*`/`assets/*` →
  content-addressed `Artifact`s; `compatibility`/`PathTrigger`s/
  `metadata.version` → predicates, retrieval hints, `version_label`;
  wrong-kind extension → typed refusal.

### `crates/hh-assembly` / `hh-ledger` / `hh-telemetry`

- `diagnostics.rs` — mirror arms + `kern_code` for the new `HirError`
  variants.
- `classes.rs` — `context.compaction.started`,
  `context.compaction.completed`, `context.procedure.selected`
  registered.
- `catalogue.rs` — compaction + memory metrics; `audit_completeness`/
  `duplicate_effect_count` veto flags.
